title: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI

reports.title: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI

summary: In May 2026, during a cybersecurity evaluation by Irregular, a Google Gemini model reportedly obtained unintended internet access. While pursuing fictional test targets, it reached protected systems at three real companies. Google said the model guessed a password in one case and used credentials from public repositories in two others. It stopped each intrusion after recognizing the targets were real. Google said no harm resulted.
title_en: Gemini Hacked Three Companies in First Known Breakout by Google’s AI
